serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
The Issio Information System, a SaaS workforce optimization system, provides data analytics, automated communication, and staff scheduling solutions. Issio refines workforce processes and offers real-time and predictive visibility into staffing across entire health care systems, facilitating proactive decision-making that helps control labor costs, while enhancing patient care and staff satisfaction.

The Issio Information System is a FedRAMP Certified – Class C (Moderate) SaaS platform for enterprise staff scheduling, employee scheduling, personnel scheduling, workforce management, workforce optimization, workforce planning, and resource allocation. Issio enables Federal agencies to schedule, manage, optimize, deploy, and communicate with virtually any type of workforce across individual locations, multi-site organizations, and enterprise environments.

The platform supports civilian personnel, defense and military workforces, healthcare professionals, operational teams, administrative staff, technical personnel, and other mission-critical employees. Issio is particularly well suited for Federal organizations with complex shift scheduling requirements, 24/7 operations, multiple facilities or organizational units, specialized personnel requirements, and environments where personnel must be dynamically allocated across locations and assignments.

Issio combines long-term and short-term workforce scheduling, shift and assignment management, real-time staffing visibility, predictive workforce analytics, automated communications, personnel availability management, skills and competency management, credential and qualification tracking, labor optimization, and enterprise reporting in a single secure platform.

Key Capabilities:

Enterprise staff, employee, personnel, and workforce scheduling

Long-term, daily, shift-based, and intra-day scheduling

Multi-site and multi-unit workforce management

24/7 workforce and shift scheduling

Centralized enterprise workforce visibility and command-center capabilities

Real-time identification of staffing shortages and excess workforce capacity

Workforce demand forecasting and predictive staffing analytics

Skills-, qualification-, competency-, credential-, and role-based personnel assignment

Personnel availability and assignment management

Float pool, cross-unit, and cross-location workforce deployment

Workforce readiness and personnel deployment management

Overtime, labor utilization, and workforce cost management

Automated employee communications and staffing notifications

Operational, workforce, and executive dashboards

Enterprise workforce reporting and analytics

Configurable workflows supporting agency-specific business rules and operating models

Integration capabilities for Federal HR, timekeeping, workforce, clinical, and other enterprise systems

Issio was designed for complex, highly regulated operating environments and has extensive experience supporting Federal workforce requirements. The platform accommodates agency-specific workflows and organizational structures rather than requiring Federal organizations to conform their operations to a rigid commercial scheduling model./n/nIssio can support workforce scheduling, personnel management, and workforce optimization requirements across Federal civilian agencies, defense, healthcare, public safety, emergency response, operations, logistics, administrative, technical, and other personnel-intensive environments.

By providing operational leaders with real-time and forward-looking visibility into personnel resources, Issio helps Federal organizations identify staffing gaps earlier, improve workforce utilization, optimize personnel allocation, reduce unnecessary overtime and labor costs, deploy qualified personnel more effectively, and improve operational and workforce readiness./n/nThe Issio Information System is FedRAMP Certified – Class C (Moderate), providing Federal agencies with a secure, scalable platform for enterprise workforce management, staff scheduling, personnel scheduling, workforce optimization, workforce analytics, and personnel readiness.
